versioning.changelog: Version 1.3.0: Merged coding-style.md and patterns.md into code-standards.md; expanded all rules to 6+ directives

increment_guide.major: Breaking changes to index structure (e.g., renamed fields, removed properties)
increment_guide.minor: New rules added, rule paths changed, or new metadata fields added
increment_guide.patch: Bug fixes, metadata corrections, or re-indexing without content changes

rules.name: agents
rules.description: Agent quick reference with categories (core, security, orchestration, domain), routing reminders, and Router self-check gates

rules.name: code-standards
rules.description: Code standards (merged from coding-style + patterns): organization, style, patterns, error handling, best practices

rules.name: git-workflow
rules.description: Git commit and branch conventions: conventional commits, Co-Authored-By format, pre-commit requirements, branch workflow

rules.name: hooks
rules.description: Hook authoring rules: stdin/stdout JSON protocol, exit codes, hook organization, graceful degradation, testing

rules.name: memory-protocol
rules.description: Memory persistence requirements: read learnings.md before starting, write to learnings/decisions/issues after completing, assume interruption

rules.name: performance
rules.description: Performance guidance: hot path optimization, token budget management, code indexing, spawn prompt efficiency, resource management

rules.name: security
rules.description: Security rules: never commit secrets, command execution safety (spawnSync, no eval), OWASP Top 10 coverage (A06, A09, A10), references to security-architect and auth-security-expert skills

rules.name: task-tracking
rules.description: Task tracking protocol: TaskUpdate(in_progress) at start, TaskUpdate(completed) after verification, TaskList() after completion

rules.name: testing
rules.description: Testing rules: TDD red-green-refactor cycle, test organization (tests/ directory), node --test runner, regression test patterns, skills references

rules.name: workspace-conventions
rules.description: Workspace file placement, naming conventions, provenance headers, forbidden locations (most-referenced rule file)
